challenges.finding: Contact follow-up: 32,697 of 37,552 seen (87.1%), below the 95% target. Of 424 validated suspects, 375 were investigated; 49 remained (34 Nord-Kivu, 15 Ituri). Kayna and Manguredjipa reported no contacts seen.

PoE/PoC: Avakubi remains closed due to insecurity. A validated suspect at Bela could not be transferred for lack of ambulance. Sud-Kivu reported 5/9 points and three points lacked isolation; Bas-Uele reported 17/20.

PCI/EDS: Ituri completed 56/78 EDS. Nord-Kivu opened 14/22 rings, decontaminated 8/17 households and equipped none of those eight; its assessed facilities averaged 28.4% PCI/WASH. Haut-Uele reported from only 4/7 zones.

Care: national isolation 1,008 conflicts with current provincial stocks summing to 1,050. Nord-Kivu had 147 patients outside CTE/CT and occupied 188/192 suspect beds. Nord-Ubangi reported an escape and isolation gaps; Ituri reported food, blood and bed-capacity gaps.

Vaccination: Ituri reported 1,613 vaccinated, 31 MAPI including five serious, and TUMAINI launch. Bas-Uele reported 1,660/13,202 vaccinated; Haut-Uele vaccination remained halted by generator failure. Nord-Kivu and Tshopo data did not arrive. Effectiveness against BDBV remains under research.

Continuity: Katwa continuity and absenteeism contingency plans remain pending. Ituri follows 472/717 survivors, with clinic overuse and stockouts. Tshopo assessments found triage, child-appointment and incinerator gaps.

CREC: Ituri reported from 10/28 zones, resolving 39/48 feedback items and 6/17 incidents. Nord-Kivu resolved 1/8 incidents. Haut-Uele temporarily suspended Bole Bole transit activities after an incident following a death.

SMSPS: Ituri supported 22/28 new confirmed cases under its pillar scope, covering 15/28 zones; Nord-Kivu supported 21/28. Haut-Uele Boma Mangbetu and Wamba data did not arrive. Nursery, nutrition, trained-personnel and mobility gaps remain.

Logistics and security: delivery of care and PCI inputs continued; Starlink renewal was being pursued for 11 North Ubangi zones. Butuhe and Avakubi remained closed due to insecurity; security support to EDS and PCI was reported.

PSEA: 2,381 people sensitised and 59 providers briefed during the reported day; cumulative 74,091 sensitised and 6,549 code-of-conduct signatures. Activity covers 56/151 zones and only 2/16 partners report, with reporting-mechanism and language gaps.

priorities.recommendation: Strengthen early detection, contact follow-up, EDS and response-team security. Recommendations do not establish completed actions.
